limits: Intrusive trace: tracing adds work to every phase, so its frame counts are not I2 figures. Waiting = preempted + wakeup latency. Preempted time is charged to the task that took the GL thread's CPU; sleep to the section open at switch-out and the task that woke it. Link threads are the app's threads named DefaultDispatch*, deathride-link*, ktor* or eventLoop*.
